description: Three eligible, plausible word-bank entries ('සල්ලි'->money, 'බස්'->bus, 'ආදරේ'->love, all human-verified/source=native or loanword). Round 4's attestation gate still applies unchanged: 'bus' and 'love' both have PRIMARY evidence (real SOLD sentences where a person actually switched to them), while 'money' has only TERTIARY evidence (excluded from the selection gate), so the plausible+attested single-word pool is exactly {'බස්','ආදරේ'} -- 'සල්ලි' can never be chosen regardless of budget. Round 5 changes HOW MANY get chosen: no longer a fixed k=2, but a budget derived from a sampled target CMI (see src/noisers/codemix.py's module docstring 'Round 5' section). At seed=56, heavy draws target_cmi=74.03 on this 3-word post, producing budget=round(0.7403*3)=2 -- enough to pack BOTH plausible+attested units ('bus' and 'love'), demonstrating heavy CAN select multiple units in one post when the sampled budget is large enough, not just the single-unit case codemix_forced_single_substitution.json and codemix_prefers_plausible.json cover.
